title: Grayton Beach "Resting Beach Face" 277 Barton's Way
h1: Grayton Beach "Resting Beach Face" 277 Barton's Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- New furnishings- Tennis/Pickleball- 2 community Pools(One pool is heated only between the dates of 11/15-12/2, 12/16-1/6, and March spring break)- Clubhouse amenities- 6-Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle**- 5 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience the luxury of Resting Beach Face, a stunning 2-story, custom-built home with 5 elegant bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, accommodating up to 12 guests. Located in the highly sought-after neighborhood of The Preserve in Grayton Beach, this home provides access to one of 30A’s most breathtaking beaches, where sugar-white sand meets the Gulf's emerald waters, only a 4-minute drive from Blue Mountain Beach Access. Guests will love exclusive access to premium amenities—including 2 community pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and other luxurious clubhouse amenities designed for relaxation and fun!Resting Beach Face has a tranquil gray façade crowned with vibrant mint shutters and a cozy sitting porch that leads to the first floor. Guests will admire the customized elements of this open floor plan, such as the white oak-colored floors, white shiplap walls, and decorative beams in the great room. Awash in natural lighting, friends and family can unwind in the living area on oversized sofas and armchairs that surround the TV. The adjacent dining area is perfect for a sit-down meal, with a dining table for 5 and bench seating on one side. The gourmet kitchen features a 4-stool breakfast bar/kitchen island with quartz countertops, decorative glass-door cabinets, and high-end appliances—including a wine fridge and an ice maker. For extra comfort, there is 1 primary bedroom and 1 bunk room with queen-over-queen beds on this floor. Gather with friends and family on the magnificent screened-in porch and patio equipped with a handy propane grill and alfresco dining table—perfect for dinner and cocktails under the stars. Don’t forget to rinse off the salt and sand in the charming cedar-enclosed outdoor shower before heading inside to relax and unwind.After a long day at the beach, guests can retire in comfort to the 3 guest bedrooms on the second floor. All the bedrooms feature a private bathroom—including one with a free-standing tub for a spa-like experience. There is also a tiled laundry room on this floor with a full-sized washer and dryer. Resting Beach Face promises a fun and relaxing getaway on the stunning Emerald Coast! With on-site parking and 4 complimentary adult bikes—plus a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle—it’s easy to explore the local area. For beach access, check out Grayton Dunes Beach, located at the end of Garfield Street. Book this incredible home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate*Please note that there is nearby construction that can be heard from time to time.*The fireplace is not for guest use.**Please note that in order to utilize the Low-Speed Vehicle that comes with the home, you will be required to pay a $30 non-refundable deposit to 30a Gulf Carts.
